{{ElectionsOH}}
The '''2026 Ohio Secretary of State election''' was held on November 3, 2026, to elect the [[secretary of state of Ohio]]. Incumbent [[Republican Party of Ohio|Republican]] Secretary of State [[Frank LaRose]] was term-limited and instead [[2026 Ohio State Auditor election|ran for state auditor]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Leigh |first=Harri |title=Ohio Secretary of State Frank LaRose announces bid for state auditor |url=https://spectrumnews1.com/oh/columbus/news/2025/02/10/frank-larose-auditor-election |date=2025-02-10 |access-date=2025-02-12 |website=[[Spectrum News#Spectrum News 1 (Ohio)|Spectrum News]]|language=en}}</ref> Primary elections were held on May 5, 2026.

Term-limited Republican state treasurer [[Robert Sprague]] ran to succeed LaRose, but was defeated by former [[Ohio House of Representatives]] minority leader [[Allison Russo]] in the general election.<ref>{{Cite web |last=BeMiller |first=Haley |date=November 3, 2026 |title=Democrat Allison Russo wins Ohio secretary of state race |url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/news/politics/elections/2026/11/03/ohio-secretary-of-state-election-results-2026/92458327007/ |url-access=limited |access-date=November 4, 2026 |website=The Columbus Dispatch}}</ref>

===Candidates===

*[[Robert Sprague]], [[Ohio state treasurer]] (2019–present) ''(previously [[2026 Ohio gubernatorial election|ran for governor]])''<ref>{{cite news |last1=Balmert |first1=Jessie |last2=BeMiller |first2=Haley |title=Ohio Treasurer Robert Sprague to run for secretary of state, backs Ramaswamy for governor |url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/news/politics/2025/02/05/robert-sprague-mounts-bid-for-secretary-of-state-backs-vivek-ramaswamy/77973361007/ |access-date=February 5, 2025 |work=[[The Columbus Dispatch]] |date=February 5, 2025}}</ref>
